title: Nazmir, the Loa, and G'huun
summary: Talanji's expedition seeks loa allies against blood trolls whose rituals serve G'huun.
opening: Nazmir held the ruins of a great troll past and a growing present danger. Talanji entered the swamp to find allies before its corruption spread.
reviewNote: Separate zone, dungeon, and Uldir raid events; verify the fates of each loa in game.

chapters.title: Into Nazmir
chapters.body: Establish the blood troll threat that Talanji refuses to ignore.

chapters.title: Seeking the loa
chapters.body: Follow appeals to Hi'reek, Bwonsamdi, Torga, and Krag'wa.

chapters.title: Corruption below
chapters.body: Trace the route toward the Underrot and its source of infection.

chapters.title: The larger danger
chapters.body: Connect the zone crisis to G'huun, with the raid outcome reviewed separately.
